question: Should the Convex AI-file automation preserve OpenClaw-compatible single-line skill frontmatter, or should multiline generator output be accepted only after the consumer parser supports it?
rationale: The files are generated, so repairing this snapshot alone would not settle whether future Convex updates may overwrite the repository's runtime compatibility requirements.

options.title: Preserve single-line metadata
options.body: Pin or post-process the generator so every `SKILL.md` description remains a single-line value before regenerating from current main.

options.title: Upgrade the consumer first
options.body: Pause this PR until OpenClaw's embedded parser explicitly supports multiline YAML values and that compatibility has shipped.

recommendation.title: Preserve single-line metadata
recommendation.body: Pin or post-process the generator so every `SKILL.md` description remains a single-line value before regenerating from current main.

likelyOwner.reason: This identity owns the recurring updater PR stream and is the best available route to the automation configuration behind it.
